question_or_proposition: For Aldrin at Outfall 001, does the effluent limits table row establish any enforceable numeric discharge limitation, or only a monitoring-and-reporting requirement with no numeric limit applicable for compliance comparison?
required_context: Page 4 effluent limits table column headers distinguishing numeric limit columns from measurement frequency and sample type
Permit-table interpretation of 'N/A' and 'Report' in effluent limit cells
Page 3 introductory language establishing permit applicability period and Outfall 001 monitoring authorization
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf Page: 4, Section: part_i, Aldrin row
notes: The nominated Aldrin row lists N/A across all numeric limit columns and 'Report' in the remaining limit field, with quarterly grab monitoring specified. Resolving whether this constitutes report-only monitoring without an enforceable numeric limit affects which discharge limits apply for compliance comparison (Purpose A) and how Aldrin results or missing Aldrin data should be classified when no ordinary numeric compliance comparison is at issue (Purpose C).
